cited.quote: institutions should not collect any fee from the students admitted into Agricultural Professional courses
selected under Government quota through single window system and pursuing Professional Courses in Government

rationale: C4 is a fee waiver GO for 7.5% government-school students, a different group. C1 is a BC/MBC first-graduate scholarship with income limits, not a fee waiver for all first-generation students irrespective of caste. No step for the promised beneficiaries.

cited.quote: Cement Concrete road will be constructed in temple car riding street in Thiruvannamalai Arulmigu Arunachaleswarar Temple

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2021-12-16 titled administrative sanction accorded, reproducing the announcement of a cement concrete road in the temple car riding street at Thiruvannamalai. This is an official step, but no extract shows the road built or operational.

cited.quote: No additional fund requests for ongoing schemes and activities will be entertained by the Finance Department

rationale: C4 and C5 are a general top-down budgeting GO (re-appropriation, fund ceilings). They are not a dedicated measure on austerity for Ministers and officials. Budget speeches C1 and C2 only mention fiscal consolidation.

cited.quote: a new adult literacy programme, Karpom Ezhuthuvom Iyakkam is being implemented in all the districts of the state

rationale: C1 describes the existing centrally shared Karpom Ezhuthuvom programme with a 3.10 lakh target. No extract shows an order launching a statewide mission for 100% literacy in three years.

cited.quote: a new adult literacy programme, Karpom Ezhuthuvom Iyakkam is being implemented in all the districts of the state
for monitoring the progress, a District Level Committee is formed

rationale: C4 forms a district committee for the AGAMT-II rural scheme, not for literacy surveys and classes. C1 and C2 describe existing adult literacy programmes. No district literacy committee is shown.

cited.quote: Allotment will also be made for the newly sanctioned colleges, if any, within the cut-off date

rationale: The extracts are admission prospectuses and ISM&H college lists. They mention newly sanctioned colleges only generically and show no order to establish a medical college in a district without one.

cited.quote: These artefacts will be displayed in a world class site museum, established at Keezhadi
new museums will be built in Villupuram and 13 Ramanathapuram districts at an estimated cost of Rs.10 crore

rationale: C4 (2021 revised budget speech) announces a site museum at Keezhadi and C2 (2022 budget) new museums elsewhere. These are budget announcements; no GO, tender or sanction for museums at Keezhadi, Adichanallur or Korkai is shown.
No extract concerns cable cars or winch lines at hill temples. C1 and C4 are about temple conservation and icon centres; C2 and C3 are the telecom policy; C5 is the energy sector.

cited.quote: This Government will continuously impress upon the Government of India to implement

rationale: C2 is a policy note stating intent to press the Union on 27% OBC reservation. This is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as a resolution, letter or GO. Other extracts do not show one.

cited.quote: Guidelines for Tourism Destination Development Scheme, 2021, appended to this order

rationale: C1 and C3 are general tourism destination guidelines and a master plan, and C2 and C5 a Covid recovery committee. None is a dedicated spiritual or pilgrimage tourism programme.

cited.quote: constitute a Committee with the following composition to come-up with a revival plan for the tourism sector
Development of niche tourism segments like adventure, eco, heritage, pilgrimage, wellness, coastal

rationale: C5 forms a committee for post-Covid tourism revival, not for designing or promoting spiritual tourism trips. C4 lists pilgrimage only as one niche segment of a general scheme. No dedicated committee is shown.

cited.quote: Inclusion of Silambam in 3 percent Sports Quota - Amendment - Orders - Issued
the discipline has been included for reservation in Government jobs provided for sports persons

rationale: C1 is G.O. Ms. No. 46 of 2021-10-29 amending the 3% sports quota to include Silambam; C2 describes the quota GOs; C5 confirms inclusion in reservation in Government jobs.

cited.quote: to sanction financial assistance to them to promote folk arts, to popularize these arts among people

rationale: C1 shows the Folk Artistes Welfare Board giving welfare assistance (spectacles, education, marriage) but no pension. Other extracts are about government employee pensions. No pension for artists is shown.

cited.quote: The recruitment process has been substantially computerised to ensure transparency and accountability

rationale: C1 and C2 policy notes describe existing computerised and credibility measures at TRB and TNPSC with no new dedicated GO, scheme or law. C4 and C5 are unrelated service rules and appointments.

No extract concerns guidelines on safeguarding agricultural produce or preventing misuse of agricultural land. C1 is about land ceilings, C2 and C3 about agricultural engineering and subsidies, C4 and C5 about guideline values of Government land.

cited.quote: following three committees are constituted, each at divisional, District and State level

rationale: C1 and C2 form monitoring committees for encroachments on water bodies and Government lands, not agricultural land misuse. C4 mentions zonal committees that 'will be formed' for farmers' welfare. C5 concerns land acquisition resettlement.

cited.quote: the certificate issuing authorities have to adopt the revised list with correct name of Scheduled Castes

rationale: C4 only instructs certificate authorities on the revised Scheduled Castes list. No extract shows a step to issue caste and income certificates to students in their schools.

cited.quote: the Government intends to develop a new airport in this region

rationale: C1 and C2 show state-led steps for Hosur and Vellore airports (land acquisition, TIDCO study, willingness to invest). No formal step urging the Union to set up new airports at the named places is shown.

cited.quote: Rota virus vaccine is being administered in Routine Immunization as 5 drops orally for infants

rationale: C2 says rotavirus vaccine is in routine immunisation but gives no date or GO, so no operationalisation by this government is shown. It shows no meningococcal vaccine, and hepatitis B only for health care workers.
No extract concerns soil research institutes in regional agricultural offices. The extracts cover a horticultural college, turmeric and organic research centres, and watershed development.
